facts.label: Where
facts.value: Online through the Online BPLS, or onsite at the Business Bureau, City Mayor's Office

facts.label: Processing
facts.value: About 2 hours 10 minutes at the Business Bureau for an online application, not counting other offices and payment

facts.label: Mayor's permit fee
facts.value: ₱1,000 to ₱10,000 depending on business type and asset size, plus regulatory fees and the business tax assessed by the City Treasurer

facts.label: Valid until
facts.value: December 31 of the year it was issued

source.label: City Government of Davao Citizen's Charter, Volume I (2024 revision)
